_comment: End-to-end scenarios for AUTHN_PROVIDER=sunbird (KBI). Only one ACR applies -- knowledge-based auth (policy number + full name + DOB). Positive uses the configured identity/knowledge answers (INDIVIDUAL_ID, KBI_FULL_NAME, KBI_DOB); negative overrides full name + DOB with deliberately wrong values and expects rejection.

scenarios.name: kbi positive: correct policy number + full name + DOB succeeds
kbi negative: wrong full name and DOB are rejected
